name: Industrial Shopfloor Reliability, Quality & EHS Safety
description: Optimizes critical spare-part safety stocks and reorder points via censored MTBF reliability modeling, builds 80/20 scrap defect Paretos with CapEx payback evaluation, and enforces strict EHS Permit-to-Work LOTO and gas-test safety gates.

skills.summary: Calculates right-censored MTBF, lead-time demand, safety stock, Reorder Point (ROP), and critical stockout expedite POs.
Builds 80/20 manufacturing scrap cost Paretos, isolates >=2x anomalous supplier lots, and computes CapEx payback hurdles.
Enforces zero-compromise LOTO isolation, confined-space O2 (19.5-23.5%), 0% LEL gas freshness, fire watch, and worker certification checks.

byo_mcp: SAP PM / Shopfloor Historian & EHS Permit MCP server
connectors.connector_fetch_guidance: Extract equipment work-order MTBF logs, spares inventory balances, QMS scrap batches, and EHS confined-space permit readings from BigQuery or customer SAP PM / Historian MCP servers via remote_cli mcp before Python safety and optimization runs.

gateway_approval_actions: Creating spare-parts purchase requisitions in customer SAP PM / ERP MCP
Signing or authorizing live Permit-to-Work (LOTO / confined space) clearances in EHS MCP
python_code_guardrails: Hard STOP_WORK_BLOCKED interlock whenever O2 < 19.5%/> 23.5%, LEL >= 10%, H2S/CO threshold breach, or missing LOTO verification
Zero-stock critical asset safety-stock floor and MTBF reorder-point calculation
Pareto 80/20 scrap concentration correlation and discounted CapEx payback bounds

scheduled_routine.name: daily-critical-spares-watch
scheduled_routine.title: Daily Critical Spares ROP Watch
scheduled_routine.instruction: Run the daily critical spare parts ROP check via scripts/mtbf_spares_optimizer.py across plant rotating equipment and flag zero-stock critical assets.
